svg.title: After the editor
svg.desc: Manuel's lowered black Audi S5 B8.5 in right-facing side-profile line art, with polished split-Y wheels, thin tyres and a boot-lip spoiler, followed by his photography and design work. After the editor. My S5 B8.5. Black, low, two-piece 20s. Photography. Cars at The ICE. Wildlife in Costa Rica. Sony α7 IV in hand. Edited in Lightroom, Photoshop and DaVinci Resolve.

g.aria-label: My S5 B8.5. Black, low, two-piece 20s.

svg.title: My S5, in profile
svg.desc: Right-facing Audi S5 B8.5 coupe in side-profile line art. Lowered suspension, slim tyres on large polished five-split-Y wheels, silver mirrors and a raised boot-lip spoiler. Light travels over the body and polished wheels while the car stays still. The B8.5 daytime-running lights keep their upper brow, swept outer hook and separated inner return as their glow brightens.

g.aria-label: Cars at The ICE. Wildlife in Costa Rica. Sony α7 IV in hand.
Edited in Lightroom, Photoshop and DaVinci Resolve.
